# Fontspector (WebAssembly build)

These two files are the [Fontspector](https://github.com/fonttools/fontspector)
check engine compiled to WebAssembly — the same `fontspector-web` crate that
powers the official web tool at https://fonttools.github.io/fontspector/.
`js/fontspector-worker.js` loads them to run the Google Fonts profile on
dropped fonts, entirely in the browser.

- Upstream: fonttools/fontspector, commit `76b618a8fcfab7f87877fb1ab58da3d49ec36d3c`
  (fontspector-web 1.6.0, built 2026-10-09)
- License: Apache-2.0 (see `LICENSE` in this folder)
- `fontspector_web.js` — generated by `wasm-bindgen --target web` (0.2.129)
- `fontspector_web_bg.wasm` — release build, then `wasm-opt -Oz`

Nothing here is modified Fontspector code. One build-time detail differs from
upstream: Fontspector's build script downloads the OpenType script/language
tag registries from learn.microsoft.com, which wasn't reachable from the build
machine, so those two lists were taken from the `opentypespec` package
(v1.9.2, same author, scraped from the same Microsoft pages: 182 script tags,
680 language tags). They only feed two checks (`opentype/layout_valid_script_tags`
and `opentype/layout_valid_language_tags`).

To update to a newer Fontspector, see "Updating the Fontspector engine" in the
main README.
